open_points.subject: M27 Actor.agent_name uniqueness enforcement
open_points.text: State 1 (M27): "names are unique in an installation, and a configuration repeating one is refused at start." vs State 2 (A16 rule 2): "Exactly three checks apply to a re-read: ... every token is at least 43 characters; no two tokens are equal." and State 3 `installation` ownership lists only token-length/token-equality checks.
open_points.question: Which module must enforce unique `agent_name` values, and at which moments (start only, or also token-list re-read)?
options: `installation` enforces unique agent names at start only (as M27 states), not on re-read
`installation` enforces unique agent names at both start and re-read (extend A16 re-read checks)
No uniqueness check for agent names (treat M27 statement as non-normative)
open_points.default_guess: `installation` enforces unique agent names at start only, and re-read keeps A16's exact three checks.
